teams-roles.heading: People and permissions
teams-roles.heading-copy: Manage your firm’s people, teams, and roles in one place.
teams-roles.people-copy: Assign each active person one role and any teams they work with.
teams-roles.people-empty: People will appear here after they are added to your firm.
teams-roles.teams-copy: Use teams to organize people. Roles, not teams, decide what a person can access.
teams-roles.roles-copy: The role matrix makes client access clear before someone opens a record.
